from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyConstructionData(BaseModel):
    """A single month's construction statistics extracted from a specific report."""
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="Date the report was released (YYYY-MM-DD), used for conflict resolution")
    report_id: str | None = Field(description="Report identifier (e.g. CB22-174)")
    data_month: str = Field(description="The month the statistics apply to (YYYY-MM)")
    permits_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Building Permits")
    starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Housing Starts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted monthly data points."""
    construction_data: list[MonthlyConstructionData]
